description: Defines the InputDispatcherPolicyInterface class, an interface for input dispatcher policies in Android, including methods for handling configuration changes, window responsiveness, input events, and system notifications.

classes.name: InputDispatcherPolicyInterface
classes.description: Interface class for input dispatcher policies, providing virtual methods for system input event notifications and handling.

methods.name: notifyConfigurationChanged
methods.description: Notifies the system of a configuration change.

methods.name: notifyNoFocusedWindowAnr
methods.description: Notifies that an application has no focused window.

methods.name: notifyWindowUnresponsive
methods.description: Notifies that a window has become unresponsive, potentially triggering an ANR.

methods.name: notifyWindowResponsive
methods.description: Notifies that a window has become responsive again.

methods.name: notifyInputChannelBroken
methods.description: Notifies that an input channel is broken.

methods.name: notifyFocusChanged
methods.description: Notifies that input focus has changed between windows.

methods.name: notifySensorEvent
methods.description: Notifies about a sensor event.

methods.name: notifySensorAccuracy
methods.description: Notifies about sensor accuracy changes.

methods.name: notifyVibratorState
methods.description: Notifies the state of the vibrator.

methods.name: getDispatcherConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the input dispatcher configuration.

methods.name: filterInputEvent
methods.description: Filters an input event; returns true to dispatch unmodified, false to consume.

methods.name: interceptKeyBeforeQueueing
methods.description: Intercepts a key event before queueing for power management or preprocessing.

methods.name: interceptMotionBeforeQueueing
methods.description: Intercepts motion events before queueing.

methods.name: interceptKeyBeforeDispatching
methods.description: Intercepts a key before dispatching.

methods.name: dispatchUnhandledKey
methods.description: Performs default processing for unhandled keys, possibly returning a fallback key event.

methods.name: notifySwitch
methods.description: Notifies about switch events.

methods.name: pokeUserActivity
methods.description: Pokes user activity for dispatched events.

methods.name: onPointerDownOutsideFocus
methods.description: Notifies that a pointer down occurred outside the focused window.

methods.name: setPointerCapture
methods.description: Changes the Pointer Capture state.

methods.name: notifyDropWindow
methods.description: Notifies that the drag window moved over another window.
